Subject: Your land dispute matter - O.S. No. 1252/2020

Dear Mr. Rajan,

Thank you for meeting us on 20 September 2020 about your dispute with Sameer Mehra. As we understand it, the occupant claims ownership by adverse possession. The matter is listed before the Hubballi District Court.

Our advice is to rebut the adverse possession claim with tax receipts showing continuous ownership. Please collect tax receipts showing continuous ownership and electricity bills and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of 65 lakh rupees.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
